title: Exponential Separation of Quantum and Classical One-Way Numbers-on-Forehead Communication
summary: Numbers-on-Forehead (NOF) communication model is a central model in communication complexity. As a restricted variant, one-way NOF model is of particular interest. Establishing strong one-way NOF lower bounds would imply circuit lower bounds, resolve well-known problems in additive combinatorics, and yield wide-ranging applications in areas such as cryptography and distributed computing. However, proving strong lower bounds in one-way NOF communication remains highly challenging; many fundamental questions in one-way NOF communication remain wide open.
